page.excerpt: Bitcoin news today centers on a selloff that erased the post-midterm rebound, as spot ETF outflows, a technology-stock rout and leveraged liquidations pushed Bitcoin back toward $76,000. Bitcoin was priced at $75,841.57 at 00:00 UTC on 7 November 2026, down 0.11% over 24 hours.
